body.text: AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER (this “Agreement”), dated as of May 1, 2024, among Alpha & Omega Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Parent”), and Beta Corp. 𝔅 Ltd., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”).
WHEREAS, the parties intend the merger to qualify under § 368(a) of the Code, as described in Section 1.1 and Section 2.1(b);

article.title: ARTICLE I DEFINITIONS
article.text: This Article I applies to the “Company” and to Parent.

section.title: Section 1.1 Definitions.
section.text: (a) “Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday — or Sunday — on which banks in New York are open; “Closing” has the meaning set forth in Section 2.1.

definition.text: “Material Adverse Effect” means any change that is material to the Company 𝔅 & its Subsidiaries, see Section 2.1(b).

section.text: (b) Each Business Day of the Company is a “Trading Day”.

section.title: Section 1.2 Untitled.
section.text: Text in a section without a uuid stays in the article container; the Closing occurs on a Business Day.

section.title: Section 2.1 Closing.
section.text: (a) The Closing shall take place on the second Business Day after the conditions in Section 1.1 are satisfied.
(b) At the Closing, the Company and Parent shall deliver the documents described in Section 2.1(a).

backMatter.text: Exhibit A – Form of Certificate; the Company’s charter, Section 1.1.
